「我们该走了。」吃完早餐，如斯带笑的对他说。

「喔。」他含糊不清的应了一声。

她好笑地看他默默收拾桌面，还是忍不住问了，「怎么了？」

他叹了口气。「我忘了问你早餐好不好吃？」

「不错呀！怎么了？」

「是我做的。」龚昊天用一双充满期待的眼眸瞅着她。

「喔——」如斯极力忍住笑意，故意没有什么太大的反应。

「就这样？」他不满地问，沮丧的表情让他看起来可怜兮兮的。

「不然你的期望是什么？」该不会要她说些什么赞美恶心的话吧？

「至少……一个小吻。」

吻还有分大小吗？看着他期待的双眼，如斯觉得自己开始心软。

「给吗？」他没有做出侵略性的动作，双眼却对她提出强烈邀请。

「什么？」如斯瞬间迷失在他魅力十足的电眼里。

「吻我。」龚昊天的嬉笑暂停，一张男性的严肃脸庞正在诱惑她行动。

她第一次发现人的眼睛竟可以变得那么深邃，像黑洞、漩涡，深不见底却又诱惑力十足……

如期用力吞咽数下，她是不是太小看他对她的影响力了？

「别诱惑我。」如斯说完，才意识到自己说了什么，赶闭上双眼，不想看到他带着调笑的表情。

她没想过自己竟然可以坦白到这个地步。

龚昊天的唇向上弯起，大掌捧起她的脸，第一个吻印在她左眼皮上，第二个吻在右眼皮——

如斯倏地睁开眼！

他仍一路向下吻去，鼻尖、脸颊、红唇、下巴、颈项，最后留连在她性感的锁骨上……

如斯近距离看着眼前这张脸，帅气的发梢，剑型的眉毛，直长的睫毛，狭长具威胁性的鹰眼，刀刻似的鼻子，还有那炽热的薄唇。

朦胧迷雾中，她想，也许她会来不及赶上飞机吧？

幸好，在最后一刻赶上飞机了，不过如斯没想到龚昊天也跟着上飞机。

当看到他在自己身边坐下时，她真的被他吓了一跳。「我去美国世出差，你去干么？」

「我也去出差。」他撇嘴笑着，模样不羁又潇洒。「记不记得我们第一次在餐厅重逢？」

「记得，我还把你整了一顿。」她不忘趁机在言语上踩他一下。

「那天我们是去庆祝公司在美国挂牌上市。」他心情好到假装没听到，反正这趟美国出差之行，他跟定了。

经过短暂对话后，如斯点点头，没说什么，倒头就睡，直到飞机抵达纽约才被他摇醒。

下机后，她马不停蹄到处参访，了解当地的艺术家，也把台湾的艺术作品积极介绍到美国。

龚昊天几乎天天跟在她身边，提醒她吃饭睡觉，有一次他离开去忙自己的事，不过才几天功夫，再回到她身边，竟看见她累出两个大大的黑眼圈，吓得他从此寸步不离待在她身边照顾她。

紧锣密鼓的十六天行程终于结束时，如斯整个人都瘦了一圈。

两人抵达机场，正准备返台，如斯突然感到一阵头晕目眩，身体晃了晃，要不是龚昊天及时一手扶住她，她说不定会当场昏倒在地。

「怎么了？」龚昊天被她吓出一身冷汗。

如斯一脸惨白的摇摇头，连说话的力气都没有。

「告诉我，到底……」他问得着急。

「我没事……」只是头有点晕而已。

龚昊天努力深呼吸好几口气，她的脸都惨白成这样，居然还跟他说没事，她没事才有鬼！

「你现在连抬头看我的力气也没有，你竟然可以对我说你没事？」如果可以伸出双手，用力摇晃这颗固执的脑袋一定很过瘾。

如斯还在想怎么粉饰太平。

「还不说？」要不是他还记得她身体不舒服，他真的会控制不了自己的焦虑。

未料，如斯然火上加油的给他虚弱地摇晃两下，一声低吼，龚昊天快速拥她入怀。

「现在不管你说什么，我们先去医院。」他霸道地道。

「我们先回台湾再说。」

「你休想！」想也没想，他一把抱起她，往机场大门口走去。

「龚昊天，别闹了，让我下来，我头痛。」如斯沉着声，虚弱地道。

龚昊天冷着脸，快步往机场外能招到出租车的地方移动。「听我的。」

她觉得自己越来越不舒服，整个人像掉进痛苦深渊里。

怎么会这样？

「我好像看不太清楚。」如斯缓缓阖上沉重的眼皮，几平没有多余的力气再睁开。

「别吓我！」见她疑似陷入昏迷，龚昊天一向稳健的步伐，也跟着乱了。

第10章(2)

一束刺目的白色灯光侵入眼内，刺破迷蒙，黑暗逐渐向两边散去，如斯缓缓地睁开眼。「昊天？」她轻唤一声后，又虚强地阖上眼。

再睡会儿吧……

倏地，一股不对劲感让她再度睁开眼睛，她将头微倾几度，一张男性脸庞映入眼底。

龚昊天趴在她身边熟睡，却连件外套也没披上，一脸的疲惫和樵悴。他怎么了？

皱了下眉头，如斯想撑起上半身，拿过椅背上的西装外套盖在他身上——

「噢！」刚有动作，如斯立刻倒抽了一口气，尖锐的刺痛窜至四肢百骸。

她的肚子怎么了？好像裂了一样。

「你干么？」乍醒的龚昊天没时间调适混沌的脑子，惊骇立刻罩上他的俊容。

她竟然给他坐起来？

「你好好躺着。」他的声音听起来像在崩溃边缘。

「我怎么了？」如斯仍支着身体，困惑的看着他过分夸张的反应。不过就是动一下而已，他有必要这样吗？

她耸耸肩，打算悠悠闲闲躺回原位，只是她怎么老觉得她的肚子怪怪的，不太对劲？

见她动得吃力，龚昊天立刻起身帮忙，虽有些手忙脚乱，却也让她不再疼痛，顺利躺下。

「你怎么了？」如斯一只手沾上他新长出来的胡碴，长了胡子的他看起来有点性格呢，想到这里，她忍不住笑了。

龚昊天没辙的朝她苦笑了一下。她到底不知道自己才是病人？握住她好奇的手，凑近嘴边，落下一个轻吻。

她终于醒来了，这比什么都好。

「你身体有没有不舒服的地方，还是觉得哪里怪怪的？」见她迟疑了下，像在想或是感觉，随即摇摇头，龚昊天才放下心。

「我怎么了？」她问。

「你生病了，在肚子开一刀，不过一切都没事了。」他一语带过这几天的过程。

「开刀？」她怎么一点记忆也没有？

「急性盲肠炎。」龚昊天无奈地说。

「急性盲肠炎？可是我痛的是头啊。」她记得她昏过去之前，的确是嚷着头痛。

龚昊天没好气地又亲了她的手一下，故作恶声恶气地道：「你还敢说！」敢情她真的痛得神智不清了，龚昊天回想自己差点和那个被他以为是蒙古大夫的医师厮杀起来，他从来安好的头颅开始隐隐作痛。

自己这辈子大概都不会忘记当医师告诉他，她只是得了急性盲肠炎时，他那股想杀人的冲动，是多么清楚让那位全身发颤的男人感觉到。

直到透过关系，找来能信任的医师，而且是六名医师共同会诊，确认无误，他才放心让医师开刀。

「哈啰。」一个身穿白袍的男子探头探脑打招呼。

「俞医师？」如斯很捧场首先回应他的招呼。

「好一点了吗？」俞思邈走近如斯的病床旁，原本打算友善地拍拍她的头，在龚昊天恶狠狠的瞪视下，硬生生收回到一半的手。

不错！感情快速成长，俞思邈摸了摸自己的下巴，嘴角藏不住笑意。

"We should go." After breakfast, she said to him with a smile.

"Oh." He responded vaguely.

She watched him silently clearing the table in amusement, but couldn't help but ask, "What's wrong?"

He sighed."I forgot to ask you if your breakfast was delicious?"

"Not bad! What's wrong?"

"I did it." Gong Haotian looked at her with a pair of expectant eyes.

"Oh——" He tried his best to hold back his smile, deliberately not reacting much.

"That's it?" he asked dissatisfiedly, his frustrated expression making him look pitiful.

"Otherwise, what were your expectations?" Shouldn't she be asked to say something disgusting and complimentary?

"At least...a little kiss."

Are there any big or small kisses?Looking into his expectant eyes, Rusu felt that her heart was starting to soften.

"Give it?" He didn't make any aggressive moves, but his eyes made a strong invitation to her.

"What?" She was instantly lost in his charming electric eyes.

"Kiss me." Gong Haotian's laughter paused, and a serious male face was tempting her to act.

For the first time, she discovered that human eyes can become so deep, like black holes and whirlpools, bottomless yet full of temptation...

Swallowing hard several times as expected, did she underestimate his influence on her?

"Don't tempt me." After saying this, she realized what she had said and quickly closed her eyes, not wanting to see his teasing expression.

She never thought that she could confess to this extent.

Gong Haotian's lips curved upward, and he held her face in his big hands. The first kiss was on her left eyelid, and the second kiss on her right eyelid——

Open your eyes so quickly!

He still kissed all the way down, to the tip of her nose, cheeks, red lips, chin, neck, and finally lingered on her sexy collarbone...

Looking at the face in front of me at such a close distance, I saw the handsome hair tips, sword-shaped eyebrows, straight long eyelashes, narrow and threatening eagle eyes, knife-carved nose, and fiery thin lips.

In the mist, she thought, maybe she would be too late to catch the plane?

Fortunately, I caught the plane at the last minute, but I didn't expect that Gong Haotian would also get on the plane.

She was really startled by him when she saw him sitting down next to her."I'm going to the United States on a business trip, what are you going to do?"

"I'm also going on a business trip." He smiled, looking uninhibited and chic."Do you remember the first time we met again in a restaurant?"

"Remember, I even punished you." She didn't forget to take the opportunity to step on him verbally.

"That day we were going to celebrate the company's listing in the United States." He was in such a good mood that he pretended not to hear it. Anyway, he had decided to go on this business trip to the United States.

After a short conversation, he nodded without saying anything and fell asleep. He was not shaken awake until the plane arrived in New York.

After getting off the plane, she visited various places non-stop to learn about local artists and actively introduced Taiwanese art works to the United States.

Gong Haotian followed her almost every day, reminding her to eat and sleep. Once he left to attend to his own affairs, but only a few days later, when he came back to her, he saw two big dark circles under her eyes from exhaustion, which frightened him so much that he stayed by her side to take care of her.

When the intense sixteen-day trip finally came to an end, I felt like I had lost a lot of weight.

The two arrived at the airport and were about to return to Taiwan when they suddenly felt dizzy and swayed. If Gong Haotian hadn't supported her in time, she might have fainted on the spot.

"What's wrong?" Gong Haotian was so frightened that he broke into a cold sweat.

He shook his head with such a pale face, not even having the strength to speak.

"Tell me, exactly..." he asked anxiously.

"I'm fine..." I'm just a little dizzy.

Gong Haotian tried to take a few deep breaths. Her face was so pale, but she actually told him that it was okay. She was the only one who was evil!

"You don't even have the strength to look up at me now, but you can actually tell me that you're okay?" It would be very enjoyable if you could stretch out your hands and shake this stubborn head vigorously.

Still thinking about how to cover up the peace.

"You haven't said anything yet?" If he hadn't remembered that she wasn't feeling well, he would have really been unable to control his anxiety.

Unexpectedly, Gong Haotian quickly hugged her into his arms after giving him a weak shake twice, adding fuel to the fire.

"No matter what you say now, let's go to the hospital first." He said domineeringly.

"Let's go back to Taiwan first."

"Don't even think about it!" Without thinking, he picked her up and walked to the airport gate.

"Gong Haotian, stop making trouble and let me down. I have a headache." He said in a calm and weak voice.

Gong Haotian had a cold face and quickly moved to where he could get a taxi outside the airport."Listen to me."

She felt more and more uncomfortable, and her whole body seemed to be falling into an abyss of pain.

how so?

"I can't seem to see clearly." He closed his heavy eyelids so slowly that he almost didn't have the energy to open them again.

"Don't scare me!" Seeing that she seemed to be in a coma, Gong Haotian's usually steady steps became disrupted.

Chapter 10(2)

A beam of dazzling white light invaded the eyes, piercing the haze. The darkness gradually dispersed to both sides, and he slowly opened his eyes."Haotian?" She called softly, then closed her eyes weakly.

Let's sleep a little longer...

Suddenly, a sense of something wrong made her open her eyes again. She tilted her head a few degrees, and a male face came into view.

Gong Haotian was sleeping soundly next to her, but he didn't even put on a coat. He looked tired and haggard.What happened to him?

Frowning, he wanted to prop up his upper body and took the suit jacket from the back of the chair to cover him——

"Oh!" As soon as he made a move, Ruzi gasped immediately, and sharp stinging pain spread to his limbs.

What happened to her belly?It seems to be cracked.

"What are you doing?" Gong Haotian, who had just woken up, had no time to adjust to his chaotic mind, and panic immediately covered his handsome face.

She actually sat up for him?

"Lie still." His voice sounded like he was on the verge of collapse.

"What's wrong with me?" Rusi still supported her body and looked at his exaggerated reaction in confusion.It's just a move. Does he need to do this?

She shrugged and planned to lie back down leisurely, but why did she always feel that her stomach was weird and something was not right?

Seeing that it was difficult for her to move, Gong Haotian immediately stood up to help. Although she was a little confused, she was able to lie down smoothly without any pain.

"What's wrong with you?" With one hand covered in his newly grown beard, he looked a bit more characterful with the beard. Thinking of this, she couldn't help but laugh.

Gong Haotian smiled wryly at her.Doesn't she know that she is the patient?He held her curious hand, brought it to her mouth, and kissed her softly.

She finally woke up and that was better than anything else.

"Is there any discomfort in your body, or do you feel something is strange?" Seeing her hesitate for a moment, as if she was thinking or feeling, and then shook her head, Gong Hao was relieved.

"What's wrong with me?" she asked.

"You were sick and had an incision in your stomach, but everything is fine." He told the story of the past few days in one word.

"Operation?" Why doesn't she have any memory?

"Acute appendicitis." Gong Haotian said helplessly.

"Acute appendicitis? But it's my head that hurts." She remembered that she did complain of a headache before she fainted.

Gong Haotian kissed her hand again angrily, pretending to be evil and said: "How dare you say that!" She was so hurt that she was delirious. Gong Haotian recalled that he almost fought with the doctor who he thought was a Mongolian doctor, and his normally healthy head began to ache.

He will probably never forget in his life that when the doctor told him that she just had acute appendicitis, his urge to kill was clearly felt by the man who was trembling all over.

It wasn't until he found a doctor he could trust through his connections, and six doctors consulted together to confirm that it was correct, that he felt safe and allowed the doctor to operate.

"Hello." A man in a white robe poked his head in greeting.

"Dr. Yu?" She responded to his greeting so flatteringly.

"Are you feeling better?" Yu Simiao approached such a hospital bed. He originally planned to pat her head in a friendly manner, but under Gong Haotian's fierce glare, he abruptly withdrew his hand halfway.

good!His feelings grew rapidly, and Yu Simiao touched his chin, unable to hide the smile on his lips.
